ADYA ORGANICS

A speculative visual campaign direction created by Kriyon Media exploring Adya Organics A2 Gir Cow Ghee across CGI motion and tactile editorial stills.

BRANDAdya Organics
SCOPECGI Product Commercial · E-Commerce Stills · Art Direction
CREATIVE DIRECTIONFarm to Jar · Golden Purity
YEAR2026

Golden purity from soil to spoon.

Created by Kriyon Media as an editorial pitch and visual brand direction for Adya Organics, this campaign explores how traditional Vedic Bilona A2 Gir Cow Ghee can be celebrated with contemporary cinematic grandeur. This is speculative work, not an official brand commission.

Combining an 11-second CGI product commercial with tactile food-macro stills, farm-to-jar storytelling, and conversion-focused e-commerce plates, the visual suite illustrates how premium nutrition brands can build uncompromising desire across paid media, digital storefronts, and brand touchpoints.
